text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, upon stepping into the VR 
Umalator, a dazzling scenery unfolded 
before my eyes...!

Oh, if it isn't little lamb-kun! It seems 
I've accidentally transferred you here as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Still, this too must be the guidance of 
the sun. If you'd like, why don't you 
travel with us?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take a journey visiting 
people's cherished landscapes. So when I 
invited the girls—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We'd love to have you! There's scenery I 
want as many people as possible to see, 
after all! So... Trainer-san, you must 
join us too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I want other people to know about 
this place filled with memories—and the 
feelings of the Satono family as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is—the place where Cla-chan and I 
received our celebrations when we enrolled 
in Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The people of the Satono family were 
overjoyed! Talking together about the 
long-cherished ambition passed down 
through generations...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To carve out a history that no one in the 
Satono family had ever achieved before— 
Yes, those feelings and hopes were 
entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Feelings entrusted from the past, huh...! 
It's truly an important memory for you!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Now then, next is Hokko Tarumae's turn!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So this is your hometown. The sea 
breeze feels wonderful, what a lovely 
town!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Tomakomai is my absolute 
favorite hometown!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's rich in nature, filled with kind 
people... I remember going fishing with 
everyone when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The neighborhood uncle taught me how to 
fish! I was so excited catching a big 
cherry salmon. ...Though sights like that 
are getting fewer now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But someday, surely—definitely! I'll bring 
back that liveliness to this place.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's a great expression. This 
really is a special place to you.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Now then! While that concludes our tour—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Will you accompany me for one more? 
There's a scenery that I really want to 
show all of you.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Sadly, it isn't a place from "my" own 
memories. Yet, it's a very special place.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's so lush and green! The scent 
of the grass is so refreshing...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored you like it! This place is my 
favorite napping spot, you see.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Originally, this was completely 
withered wasteland.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Over the course of eternal time, what was 
once a vast grassland transformed into a 
desolate wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Historical records were so scarce it was a 
struggle, but I restored it bit by bit. 
Now, it's gradually regaining its original 
scenery.
choice_data_list: Why go out of your way for a wasteland...?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Because this is the place once loved by 
the Horse Girl known as Darley Arabian.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
While watched over by someone dear to her, 
she loved nothing more than galloping 
across this endless meadow— so the records 
say.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The scenery she loved had been lost to 
time. The thought of that pained my heart 
terribly.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Just as shadows are born where the sun 
shines, perhaps beginnings and endings 
cannot be separated.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Even so, in this world, aren't there 
things you simply never want to see 
vanish?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same... The ambition handed down 
through the Satono line, that I wished to 
fulfill... Reaching the pinnacle—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(The scenery connecting past to present. 
If it's the pain of seeing that disappear, 
I know it too—)

text_block_list.name: Diamond & Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have an "oath" I want to protect 
too...!/I have a "hometown" I want to 
protect too...!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
The scenery she loved exists only in this 
world. In reality, barren wilderness 
likely still stretches on.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Even if others call it mere 
self-satisfaction, I wanted to behold the 
scenery she cherished.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That's why I brought you here! Because 
inside your souls, it seems you both 
possess precious things you never want to 
see fade away!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Simply believe in yourselves and forge 
ahead. The ones who will carry it into the 
future are you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things inherited from the past. Watching 
the two vow to protect them, Darley 
Arabian smiled gently.
